title: WebSocket

fields.name: format
fields.description: Specify the data format to be used in the HTTP request body.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Add a HTTP header key/value pair.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target WebSocket Server.

fields.name: json_date_format
fields.description: Specify the format of the date.

fields.name: json_date_key
fields.description: Specify the name of the date field in output.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target WebSocket Server.

fields.name: uri
fields.description: Specify an optional HTTP URI for the target WebSocket server.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/4.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The WebSocket output plugin lets you flush your records into a WebSocket endpoint.
